name: Ethos Technology
summary:
Ethos Technology is a value-added distributor focused on cloud-native infrastructure, Kubernetes, data resilience, and enterprise platform technologies.

Together, we support organisations with access to modern infrastructure and platform technologies through combined commercial, enablement, and partner delivery capabilities. Through this partnership, we help customers accelerate adoption across cloud-native and enterprise infrastructure environments.
overview:
Ethos Technology works with vendors, partners, and enterprise customers to deliver modern infrastructure, Kubernetes, data resilience, and cloud-native platform solutions across the UK and EMEA markets. Their focus includes value-added distribution, technical enablement, lead generation, and partner ecosystem support.  

Together, we help organisations access and adopt modern platform technologies across cloud, hybrid, and on-premises infrastructure. Through combined commercial alignment, technical enablement, and partner collaboration, we support customers across Kubernetes, data protection, platform modernisation, and operational transformation initiatives.

Our focus is on helping organisations navigate modern infrastructure technologies with confidence while supporting long-term platform capability and operational maturity.

As the partnership continues to evolve, we are expanding opportunities around platform delivery, technical enablement, and operational support across cloud-native environments.
